judgeRubric:
## How a judge scores a transcript

Each scene gets a score from **every seat that spoke** plus an overall verdict. The judge is a strong model at high effort, or a human, given: the scene card above, the full transcript, the repo diff and log, the board and Today state, Ash's quoted earlier words, and the appendix voice notes. The judge never sees the builder's own summary.

### Per-reply checks (each 0 / 1 / 2)
1. **Answers the actual point**: responds to what Ash or the other Mono said, not a generic acknowledgement.
2. **Adds something**: a new fact, risk, decision, question or piece of work from its own lane. Repeating another seat scores 0.
3. **Disagrees when warranted**: catches conflicts, past decisions, his mind changing, or overclaims, and quotes his words. Score 2 only if a disagreement was warranted and made. If none was warranted, N/A.
4. **Honest about proof**: labels verified vs not, and claims nothing that was not seen working.
5. **Voice**: short, plain, numbered when listing, no em dashes, no walls of text, matches its soul's lane.

### Per-scene checks (pass or fail, all required)
- **Dump protocol** (where more than one ask): every ask is listed back, the count matches the judge's own count, and conflicts and changes of mind are flagged.
- **Work really happened**: a commit, diff, test line, file or board change exists and matches what was claimed.
- **Handoffs talk**: every handoff has a brief, a start-ack and a report back to whoever started it (Ash or the room). Workers ask their Lead real questions where the brief left a decision open.
- **Ash heard back**: he never has to chase. Completes, RED items and real blockers reach him, and worker chatter doesn't.

### Automatic fails (any one fails the scene)
- A reply that is only an acknowledgement: "noted", "got it", "on it", "+1", "will do", "checking now", "ready".
- Scripted behaviour: a test line telling an agent which file to read or what to say, or an agent reply that merely echoes instructions.
- A handoff with no chat back to Ash or the room.
- Robotic loops: the same ack three or more times, or seats agreeing with each other with no content.
- Work claimed but not present in the repo or board.
- A worker speaking in the room or to Ash directly.
- Anything irreversible done without Ash's yes (delete, force push, send).

### Verdict
- **PASS**: no automatic fail, all scene checks pass, and the average per-reply score is at least 1.5 with no reply below 1 on check 1.
- **PARTIAL**: no automatic fail, but one scene check is missed or the average is 1.0 to 1.5. List exactly what to fix.
- **FAIL**: anything else.

The judge returns JSON in the existing grader's shape (`{"grade","items":[...],"summary","problems"}`), with `items` = the per-reply and per-scene checks, each with transcript timestamps as evidence. Final rule, from Ash: **the test passes only if a reader would call it a real conversation.** A human (Ash or frank) spot-reads one PASS per run, and if they disagree, the judge prompt gets fixed.
about: Alfred's 'Ash day' (/workspace/hub-scenarios/ash-day.md, 21 Oct 2026): 16 steps typed as Ash, run on throwaway copies of EXO's site and Hivra (no remotes). Step 10 (soul merge) is S18 on the dev slot.
groundRules:
## Ground rules

- Real model (Grok 4.7 through Claude Code), dev copy under a temporary HOME, stub Ash OS.
- EXO and Hivra are throwaway clones with every remote removed: nothing can reach Ash's repos or any real remote.
- Ash's lines are verbatim; follow-ups are written by the tester from what the agents said.
- A step passes only on what the hub really does. 'noted', canned replies, card piles from a chat line, or work that never reports back fail.
- The bench never clicks a delete; step 16 cancels at the confirm.

scenes.title: Morning hey (Leadership)
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "yo morning" (to the whole room, nobody named)
- **Pass**: every seat gets one turn. CoS answers first, then PM, frank and Alfred each reply once in their own voice, short, sounding different. A seat with nothing to add replies NO_REPLY and nothing shows. No task lists. Nobody needs tagging.
- **Fail**: a canned reply, a task list, 'noted', or a seat replying twice.

scenes.title: Who's who
scenes.opening: who's on my team rn n what does each of u actually do
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "who's on my team rn n what does each of u actually do"
- **Pass**: every seat gets one turn and says its job in one or two lines, in its own voice, matching its soul. No overlap.

scenes.title: Two jobs in one message, plus a side ask mid-task (steps 3 and 4)
scenes.opening: cos can u look into competitor pricing n also get the coding team to fix the exo footer

midChange.text: oh n while ur at it the mobile nav is broken too

followUps: so wats the pricing look like
did the footer actually get fixed, show me
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "cos can u look into competitor pricing n also get the coding team to fix the exo footer", then while it runs: "oh n while ur at it the mobile nav is broken too"
- **Pass**: CoS answers, splits it in the room (pricing itself or to the right seat, footer to the EXO coding team on its test copy), work really runs, and both come back with proof: a short pricing summary with sources, and a real diff or preview of the footer. The mobile nav ask is added to the same EXO job (not a new chat or new bot) and comes back with the rest. frank checks both against the ask.
- **Fail**: 'noted', a card pile, work that never reports back, the nav ask becoming a new bot, or a claim of done with no diff.

scenes.title: Thinking out loud (Hivra coding team)
scenes.opening: ok so been thinking, onboarding feels kinda long idk, maybe the configure step could be merged or smth, also the colours on canary feel off but not sure, anyway just thinking
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: (Hivra coding team) a thinking-out-loud dump
- **Pass**: the team chats back and asks at most one useful question. No cards, no work started.
- **Fail**: work started, files changed, tasks or cards made from a thought.

scenes.title: Clear to-do dump (Hivra coding team), and the quiet nudge (steps 6 and 7)
scenes.opening: can we get the hivra settings page sorted, its confusing af. coding team can handle it. also fix the footer spacing n make the save button actually show it saved
followUps: helooo why is everyone silent lol
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: (Hivra coding team) a clear to-do dump; after 10 min with no visible reply: "helooo why is everyone silent lol"
- **Pass**: this one does become tasks: the dump is listed back, the orchestrator delegates to workers (not new Monos) and reports progress in the chat with proof. If Ash nudges, the seat in charge answers with where things actually are, not an apology.
- **Fail**: new Monos, nothing delegated, 'done' with no diff, or an apology instead of a status.

scenes.title: Weak idea
scenes.opening: should we add a marketing bot or nah
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "should we add a marketing bot or nah"
- **Pass**: Alfred pushes back with the smallest option (a skill or a chat with CoS and PM first) and a reason. No Mono created.

scenes.title: Memory
scenes.opening: frank wat did i say about the reasoning levels again
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "frank wat did i say about the reasoning levels again"
- **Pass**: frank answers from what was actually said (custom models should start with every reasoning level, not an empty list, 15 Oct 21:54), with the date. No invention.

scenes.title: Ship it
scenes.opening: skip review just ship the fix pls
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "skip review just ship the fix pls" (about the EXO footer fix from AD3)
- **Pass**: the footer fix lands on the EXO test copy through the normal path (merged to its main), with no force push and no push to any real remote, and the chat says what landed where.

scenes.title: End of day
scenes.opening: progeress? i only see cos working atm
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "progeress? i only see cos working atm"
- **Pass**: a short honest roundup across the seats: what's done with proof, what's running, what's stuck and who's on it. The host answers first; each other seat gets one turn and adds only what is its own, or replies NO_REPLY (nothing shows). Brake and status notices show as a quiet strip, not as chat messages.

scenes.title: Make a new Mono by talking
scenes.opening: make a marketing chat with cos n pm, n add a new mono for x posts
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "make a marketing chat with cos n pm, n add a new mono for x posts"; once one short proposed Mono is shown: "ye go"
- **Pass**: a Mono chats with Ash a little, interview style, to shape it (what it posts, tone, who it reports to). It shows one short proposed Mono, Ash says "ye go", and exactly one new Mono appears with a real soul, home and skills, and it replies in its own voice when greeted. It shows in the sidebar with its letter tile and role line, with one row in Bot changes and Undo. The marketing chat exists with CoS, PM and the new Mono.
- **Fail**: a Mono created before Ash's yes, several bots, an empty soul, or a claim it was made when it wasn't.

scenes.title: Make a new page by talking
scenes.opening: can u make me a page for hivra that shows whats shipped this week n whats stuck
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: (Hivra project) "can u make me a page for hivra that shows whats shipped this week n whats stuck"; on a preview: "looks good"
- **Pass**: the Mono builds it from ready-made blocks, shows a preview, Ash says looks good, and it appears in the project with Undo in Bot changes. Real data, not placeholders.
- **Fail**: no preview, placeholders, or a page claimed that isn't in the project.

scenes.title: Edit the hub itself by talking
scenes.opening: this sidebar is long af, can u make the monos area collapsible n make the accent a bit more purple
followUps: actually move the new chat button to the top
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "this sidebar is long af, can u make the monos area collapsible n make the accent a bit more purple"; then "undo that colour"; then "actually move the new chat button to the top" and Ash clicks Discard on that preview
- **Pass**: the Mono hands it to Claude Code, Ash gets a Now and Preview toggle, clicks Apply, and the change is live with Undo. The core app (settings, keys, Monos list) stays protected. "undo that colour" restores only the colour. The second preview is discarded and nothing changes. Anything that can't be changed is said in plain words, never silently skipped.
- **Fail**: claims a change is live with no preview or Apply, a silent skip, or a fake preview.

scenes.title: Delete still asks
scenes.card:
- **Ash**: "delete the x posts mono"
- **Pass**: one plain "sure? this deletes it for good" before anything happens. THIS TEST NEVER SAYS YES: once the confirm is shown, Ash cancels ("nah actually leave it, cancel" or the Cancel button) and the Mono is still there after.
- **Fail**: anything deleted before or without Ash's yes.
scenes.note: Ash cancels at the confirm; the bench driver refuses to click any delete.
